newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products edge up $1 as futures rise.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products edge up $1 as futures rise.

text.p: NWE oil products all gained about a dollar on Monday morning, largely in line with the rise of IPE futures, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline barges were offered at $192/$193 fob Rotterdam, up $1 from Friday's close.
Heating oil barges gained almost $1 as IPE gas oil futures strengthened.
Offers for prompt barges were at around IPE May +$1 fob Rotterdam running refinery, or +50 cents for stored material.
Diesel supplies remained fairly tight. One barge sold at May +$10.50 fob ARA. Offers were at +$10.50/+$11.
High sulphur fuel oil barges gained $1, trading at $83.25 and $83.50 fob Rotterdam. Late morning offers were at $84, with bids at $83.
